issues.detail: The Hebrew place name נַחַל הַבְּשׂוֹר (Nahal Besor, 'the Besor brook/valley') is rendered as '比色雅溪谷' (Biseya valley). The transliteration '比色雅' does not match the Hebrew 'Besor' (בְּשׂוֹר); it appears to be a different name (possibly confused with another place). The correct rendering should be something like '比索溪谷' or '比梭溪谷'.
